intended_object: The canonical R-linear inclusion of R (the "integral" pseudo-measures, e.g. measures Λ(G)) into the R-submodule of pseudo-measures of Q, r ↦ algebraMap R Q r (from the docstring and module documentation).
explanation: The body is `Algebra.linearMap R Q` with its codomain restricted to `pseudomeasures δ Q`. Membership holds because (δ g − 1)·r already comes from R (`algebraMap_mem_pseudomeasures`). This is exactly the canonical map from R into the pseudo-measures. It is R-linear, its value in Q is algebraMap r (`coe_integral`), and it is injective when Q is a faithful R-algebra. The setting (any monoid G, any commutative ring R, any commutative R-algebra Q) is fully general. Pseudo-measures are this library's own notion, so Mathlib has no counterpart for the map. The definition reuses Mathlib's `Algebra.linearMap` together with `LinearMap.codRestrict`.
